newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London hold their ground.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London hold their ground.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded in London had a quiet, steady session on Monday following around 900 point fall in the Nikkei Dow over the past week, dealers said.

"There has been some bargain hunting but investors are not wholly convinced (of a market turnaround)," said one dealer, adding the fact that the Nikkei had managed to lift itself off from its lows of around 19,456 was enough to entice some buying interest in London.
Japanese exporters attracted two-way interest but the recent plunge in Tokyo had choked off much investor participation.

By 1515 GMT, the Nikkei 50 index was up 2.00 points at 1,671.59 despite the Nikkei index shedding 136.31 points to 19,668.07 in Tokyo from doubts over Japan's ability to make a swift economic recovery.
